lines.text: The three men stopped answering Job, and Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite burned with anger against Job.
Elihu was angry at the three friends for condemning Job without refuting him, and he waited because they were older.
Elihu said he was timid because he was young, but the breath of the Almighty gives a man understanding.
Elihu said no one proved Job wrong, and warned against claiming that Satan, not man, should refute him.
Elihu said he was full of words, like a clay jar about to burst, and he would flatter no one.
